lines.zh: 沙地上的脚步声沉重而有力。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps on the sand.

lines.zh: 角鼻龙拖动沉重的身体行走。
lines.en: Ceratosaurus drags its heavy body.
Tail swings, kicking up sand.

lines.zh: 沙丘间的步伐坚定而迅速。
lines.en: Steady and swift steps on the dunes.

lines.zh: 锋利的牙齿在阳光下闪着光。
lines.en: Sharp teeth glint in the sun.
Moving forward, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 沙地上的足迹逐渐消失。
lines.en: Footprints fade into the sand.
Footsteps grow distant.
Swiftly crossing the sand.
A series of footprints in the sand
My nose horn swings low over the sand.

lines.zh: 三趾脚印一路留在沙上。
lines.en: Three-toed prints trail behind me.
I stride across the sun-hot gravel.

lines.zh: 尾巴平衡着沉重的身体。
lines.en: My tail balances this heavy body.
Standing quietly, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 用锐利的双眼搜寻周围。
lines.en: Sharp eyes scanning the surroundings.

lines.zh: 慢慢转动脑袋，巡视四方。
lines.en: Slowly turning head to survey.
Standing still, waiting in the sun.
Standing leisurely on a dune.

lines.zh: 沙地上的影子投射在它身上。
lines.en: Shadow cast by the sand on it.
Staring into the distance.
Enjoying the desert's peace.

lines.zh: 沙烫着肚皮，我摊开四肢。
lines.en: Hot sand on my belly, I sprawl out.
Silent guardian of the desert.

lines.zh: 半张着嘴散热，一动不动。
lines.en: Jaws half open to cool off, I stand still.

lines.zh: 在沙丘背风处刨了个坑。
lines.en: I scrape a hollow on the lee side of a dune.
My nose horn scrapes a dry bush.
I lift my head and taste the far wind.

lines.zh: 突然抬起头，注视着玩家。
lines.en: Head suddenly rises to look at the player.

lines.zh: 鼻角一低，沙漠的沙先飞。
lines.en: Nose horn lowered, the desert sand flies first.
Head turns towards the player.

lines.zh: 用目光警告玩家靠近的危险。
lines.en: Warning gaze towards the player.

lines.zh: 沙漠的热气里，我抬起鼻子。
lines.en: In desert heat I lift my snout.

lines.zh: 鼻角压低，我盯着你的膝。
lines.en: Horn lowered, I fix on your knee.

lines.zh: 热风里，我的眼珠跟着你转。
lines.en: In the hot wind, my eye tracks you.

lines.zh: 你举起火把，我退到沙丘后。
lines.en: You raise a torch; I withdraw behind the dune.

lines.zh: 警惕地盯着走近的玩家。
lines.en: Staring intently at the player approaching.
In the desert wind, my horn points at you.
Nose horn aimed at you, eyes unmoving.

lines.zh: 从沙丘后探出半个脑袋。
lines.en: Half my head shows over the dune.
A low growl rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 把你和周围的动物比了比。
lines.en: I size you up against the other animals.

lines.zh: 歪头看你手里有没有肉。
lines.en: I tilt my head to check for meat.
I remember the meat you fed me.

lines.zh: 这一口没咬实，我吼了一声。
lines.en: That bite landed badly; I let out a roar.
makes hissing noises in pain
makes a wailing sound
hisses, Ouch!
makes a sorrowful cry
shudders and cries in pain

lines.zh: 痛从鼻角一路窜到尾巴。
lines.en: Pain runs from my horn all the way to my tail.
hisses, Ouch, it hurts!
growsls in pain

lines.zh: 沙地太硬，我的角撞得发麻。
lines.en: The sand is hard; my horn is numb.

lines.zh: 角鼻龙闻到了肉香，露出锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: Ceratosaurus caught the scent, revealing its sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 肉块在空中吸引来角鼻龙的注意。
lines.en: A meat chunk catches Ceratosaurus's attention.
It glares at the meat in your hand.

lines.zh: 你扔了一块肉，角鼻龙立刻扑了过去。
lines.en: You threw a piece of meat, and Ceratosaurus lunged for it.
This piece of meat is enough to tame it.

lines.zh: 它的角和牙齿显得非常致命。
lines.en: Its horn and teeth are deadly.
The meat draws it closer.
Meat is its favorite.
It touches your hand with its horn.

lines.zh: 你给了它一块特别大的肉。
lines.en: You gave it a particularly large chunk of meat.
You collide with Ceratosaurus.

lines.zh: 它的体型太大，你避让不及。
lines.en: Its size makes you hard to avoid.

lines.zh: 碰撞中你感到一阵剧痛。
lines.en: The impact sends pain through you.

lines.zh: 你和角鼻龙撞了个满怀。
lines.en: You crash into Ceratosaurus.

lines.zh: 它庞大的身躯让你难以应对。
lines.en: Its massive body is hard to handle.

lines.zh: 巨大的冲击力让你喘不过气。
lines.en: The force of the impact leaves you breathless.

lines.zh: 碰撞后你感到非常疲惫。
lines.en: You feel very fatigued after the collision.

lines.zh: 巨大的碰撞力几乎将你击倒。
lines.en: The collision force nearly knocks you down.

lines.zh: 角鼻龙的巨大体型造成了巨大碰撞。
lines.en: Ceratosaurus's large size creates a massive collision.
You try to avoid its collision.

lines.zh: 角鼻龙找到了一个理想的伴侣。
lines.en: Ceratosaurus found a suitable mate.
It started looking for a mate.

lines.zh: 一对角鼻龙在沙漠中相遇。
lines.en: A pair of Ceratosaurus meet in the desert.
Two Ceratosaurus begin mating.
They mate in the sand.

lines.zh: 角鼻龙寻找伴侣时发出低吼。
lines.en: Ceratosaurus rumbles to find a mate.

lines.zh: 它们互相梳理对方的毛发。
lines.en: They groom each other.

lines.zh: 角鼻龙在交配中发出低沉的声音。
lines.en: Ceratosaurus make low sounds during mating.

lines.zh: 它们在沙漠中互相依偎。
lines.en: They cuddle in the desert.

lines.zh: 角鼻龙用它的角轻轻触碰对方。
lines.en: Ceratosaurus gently touches its mate with its horn.
Large body, coming to munch you.

lines.zh: 沙地上的庞然大物，来了。
lines.en: Leviathan of the sands, here it comes.
Carnivore, here I come.
Ceratosaurus, desert king.
Seeing you, here I come.

lines.zh: 装备角鼻龙铠，提升防御。
lines.en: Wearing Ceratosaurus armor, boosted defense.
Tame me, I'll be stronger.
Drops bones, for armor.
Active attack, danger nearby.
Sandy predator, here it comes.
Locked target, ready to eat.
Prey in sight, ready to bite.
Target locked, approaching prey.

lines.zh: 你的影子在沙上，我咬住它。
lines.en: Your shadow lies on the sand; I bite at it.
Prey locked, closing in.

lines.zh: 沙漠里没水，只有我的脚印。
lines.en: No water in this desert. Only my tracks.

lines.zh: 沙丘下面，我已经算好距离。
lines.en: Below the dune, I have already judged the distance.
Locked prey, ready to bite.
Locked target, hunting starts.

lines.zh: 沙丘下有个会动的影子。
lines.en: Something moves below the dune.

lines.zh: 风把猎物的气味送过来。
lines.en: The wind carries the smell of prey.
One bite will do real damage.
It is smaller than me; go after it.
Take the one that strayed first.

lines.zh: 沙漠的热浪里，我压低鼻角。
lines.en: In the desert heat I lower my nose horn.
Targeted, attack initiated.

lines.zh: 步子压得很低，沙不发声。
lines.en: I keep low so the sand stays silent.
Targeted, hunting initiated.

lines.zh: 尾巴先扫过去，牙随后到。
lines.en: My tail sweeps first; the teeth follow.
Targeted, attack confirmed.
Targeted, eating initiated.

lines.zh: 沙地上的脚印，就是晚饭。
lines.en: Footprints in the sand are dinner.
Targeted, biting initiated.

lines.zh: 沙漠的沙，把我的牙磨快了。
lines.en: Desert sand has honed my teeth.
I drop low, tail pulled straight.
Step by step I close the gap.
I wait for it to turn, then lunge.
My teeth are already showing.
I swing around the side to cut it off.
Roar and shake the earth!
Roar and charge at the prey!

lines.zh: 用獠牙撕裂敌人的皮肉！
lines.en: Tear the enemy's skin with fangs!
Swing the horn and attack!
Breathe fire and burn the enemy!

lines.zh: 用爪子抓穿猎物的皮肉！
lines.en: Scratch the prey's skin with claws!
Sharp teeth bite through bone!
Swing the tail and knock down!

lines.zh: 咆哮中释放狂野的力量！
lines.en: Release the wild power in a roar!

lines.zh: 角鼻龙的咆哮回荡沙漠！
lines.en: Ceratosaurus's roar echoes in the desert!
I bite down and shake to tear!
Forelegs pin it, jaws press down!
My nose horn flips the prey over!
My tail sweeps up a cloud of sand!

lines.zh: 在沙丘间游荡，等待猎物出现！
lines.en: Wander in the dunes, waiting for prey!
Approaches silently in a sandstorm!
Appears in the desert at dusk!

lines.zh: 寻找猎物，游荡在无垠沙海！
lines.en: Wanders in the endless sea of sand, seeking prey!
Desert's lonely ruler!

lines.zh: 在烈日下寻找猎物的影子！
lines.en: Search for prey's shadow under the sun!
Moves silently, sand obscuring its path!

lines.zh: 在烈日炙烤下，它悄然潜行！
lines.en: Moves silently under the sun's harsh glare!
Appears in the dune at dusk!

lines.zh: 沙海中游荡，静待猎物出现！
lines.en: Wanders in the sand, waiting for prey!

lines.zh: 沙丘背后站起一头角鼻龙。
lines.en: A ceratosaurus rises behind the dune.

lines.zh: 热浪里走出一个巨大的影子。
lines.en: A huge shape walks out of the heat haze.

lines.zh: 它从干涸的河床爬上来。
lines.en: It climbs out of the dry riverbed.
The sandstorm stops, and there it stands.

lines.zh: 正午的沙漠多了一串脚印。
lines.en: Noon desert gains a line of prints.

lines.zh: 远处传来沉重的落地声。
lines.en: Heavy footfalls come from far off.

lines.zh: 一头野生的角鼻龙踱进视野。
lines.en: A wild ceratosaurus walks into view.

lines.zh: 沙地上，鼻角先露了出来。
lines.en: On the sand, the nose horn shows first.
The desert sun burns hotter than fire.
The sand is too soft to catch me.

lines.zh: 沙地渗水，我的爪子抓不住底。
lines.en: Water seeps through the sand; my claws find no grip.
The blast threw me into the sand.
hit by an arrow
burned by magic
starves to the point of injury
hit by lightning
No prey left to bite in this sand.
